AN ILLUSTRATIVE WORLD · NOT TO SCALE

INSIDE A DATACENTER

The cloud is a place.

This interactive landscape introduces the systems behind digital services. Scroll to move through six chapters. Select equipment in the world for a closer look, or open the equipment guide in any chapter.

Drag sideways or use the rotate buttons to turn the view. The arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down, keys 1–6 and the chapter controls move between stops. Reduced-motion settings are respected, and ambient motion can be paused.

The facility is illustrative and not to scale. It combines air and liquid cooling to explain their roles. Real equipment arrangements and redundancy designs vary. This is not live operational data.

For a full course on AI data centers, see From Watts to Tokens.

Inspired by the spatial, pixel-built world of the Yamauchi No.10 Family Office (opens in a new tab). The geometry and learning content here are original.
